title: Extremal chromatic bounds for distance Laplacian eigenvalues
summary: For a connected simple graph $G$ on $n$ vertices with chromatic number $χ$, the distance Laplacian matrix is $\DL(G)=\operatorname{diag}(\Tr_G(v_1),\dots,\Tr_G(v_n))-D(G)$, where $D(G)$ is the distance matrix and $\Tr_G(v)=\sum_{u\in V(G)} d_G(u,v)$ is the transmission. The eigenvalues of $\DL(G)$ are ordered as $\partial^{L}_1(G)\ge \partial^{L}_2(G)\ge \cdots \ge \partial^{L}_n(G)=0$.
